}}

{{recipe}}


If you like, you can substitute turkey, beef, or even tuna for the chicken.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] shredded cooked [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]]
* 3 cups [[Cookbook:Cornbread (disambiguation)|cornbread]], crumbled finely
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] salt
* ¼ tsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* ½ large [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 2 cups shredded [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|Monterey Jack cheese]], divided
* 2 tbsp unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* ⅔ cup dried [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|breadcrumbs]]
* ¼ cup unsalted melted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]

== Procedure ==
#In a large straight-sided stainless steel [[Cookbook:Sauté Pan|sauté pan]] set over medium-high heat, melt butter with olive oil. Add onion and cook until onion is translucent.
#Add garlic and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] until golden. Remove and set aside until cool.
#Combine chicken with onion mixture along with the salt, pepper, and 1 cup cheese. Set aside.
#Place enough cornbread in the bottom of a [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]]-lined high-sided roasting pan to lightly coat the bottom. Place a layer of chicken mixture on top and repeat until all has been used up.
#Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle over top layer. Cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]] and place in the center of a 375°F oven 20 minutes.
#Remove foil and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] for 15 more minutes or until browned and bubbly on top. Serve warm.
